metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.displayName: CVE-2026-20349 — Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD)  Exploitation
properties.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-20349: Cisco Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) contain a heap inspection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause the device to reload unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) condition.. Product: Secure Firewall Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD)
properties.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "CVE-2026-20349" or Message contains "SECURE FIREWALL ADAPTIVE SECURITY APPLIANCE (ASA) AND SECURE FIREWALL THREAT DEFENSE (FTD)" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), clientIp_s | where count_ > 3
